executable_template.applicability_check: Run the branch KB validator against an otherwise schema-valid fixes JSON document whose raw git object ends with two LF bytes; the vulnerable implementation returns ok=true while git diff --check reports a new blank line at EOF.
executable_template.patch_strategy: Read git show with raw terminal whitespace preserved, require the document to equal its trailing-whitespace-stripped body plus exactly one LF before JSON parsing, remove the malformed blank line, and retain focused rejection coverage.
executable_template.rollback_plan: Revert the raw git-show read, EOF check, focused regression, and this KB entry together; keep unattended auto-merge disabled for KB-changing branches until equivalent raw-file validation exists.
